```{r}
extract_pcgroups <- function(CAMERA_FT, StM16_target, 
                             mz_tol = 0.001, rt_tol = 1) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  
  # ---- helper function for a single compound ----
  find_pcgroup_features <- function(compound_name, target_mz, target_rt) {
    
    # Step 1: find closest mz + rt match
    match_row <- CAMERA_FT %>%
      mutate(
        mz_diff = abs(mz - target_mz),
        rt_diff = abs(rt - target_rt)
      ) %>%
      filter(mz_diff <= mz_tol, rt_diff <= rt_tol) %>%
      arrange(mz_diff + rt_diff) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    # if no match found → return NULL
    if (nrow(match_row) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # Step 2: extract pcgroup
    pc <- match_row$pcgroup
    
    # Step 3: all features in this pcgroup
    pc_features <- CAMERA_FT %>%
      filter(pcgroup == pc) %>%
      mutate(
        Compound = compound_name,
        matched_pcgroup = pc
      )
    
    return(pc_features)
  }
  StM16_target$Compound <- trimws(StM16_target$Compound)

  # ---- apply function to all compounds ----
  results_list <- pmap(
    list(StM16_target$Compound,
         StM16_target$m.z,
         StM16_target$RT..s.),
    find_pcgroup_features
  )
  
  # remove compounds that produced no match
  results_list <- results_list[!sapply(results_list, is.null)]
  
  # combine results
  final_results <- bind_rows(results_list) %>% 
    dplyr::select(feature_name, mz, rt, isotopes, adduct, pcgroup, Compound, matched_pcgroup)
  
  return(final_results)
}

```

```{r}
match_pcgroup_to_library <- function(pcgroup_result, inhouse_lib_MS1,
                                     mz_tol = 0.01) {

  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  
  # extract library names
  lib_names <- sapply(inhouse_lib_MS1, function(x) x$Name)
  
  # function to match a single compound group
  match_single_compound <- function(df) {
    
    comp <- unique(df$Compound)
    
    # find matching library index
    lib_idx <- which(lib_names == comp)
    
    # if no library entry exists → mark FALSE for all rows
    if (length(lib_idx) == 0) {
      df$library_match <- FALSE
      return(df)
    }
    
    # get library mz peaks
    lib_mz <- inhouse_lib_MS1[[lib_idx]]$Peaks$mz
    
    # for each feature row in pcgroup: check if any mz matches library
    df$library_match <- sapply(df$mz, function(feature_mz) {
      any(abs(feature_mz - lib_mz) <= mz_tol)
    })
    
    return(df)
  }
  
  # split by compound before matching
  result <- pcgroup_result %>%
    split(.$Compound) %>%
    map_df(match_single_compound)
  
  return(result)
}

```

```{r}
export_pcgroups_to_xlsx <- function(df, file = "pcgroup_export.xlsx") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(purrr)
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  
  split_list <- split(df, df$pcgroup)
  
  walk(split_list, function(group_df) {
    
    # COLLAPSE multiple compounds if present (fix for your error)
    comp_raw <- unique(group_df$Compound)
    comp <- paste(comp_raw, collapse = "_")  # ALWAYS length 1
    
    pcg  <- unique(group_df$pcgroup)
    
    # Safe sheet name
    sheet_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", comp), "_pc", pcg)
    sheet_name <- substr(sheet_name, 1, 31)  # Excel allows max 31 chars
    
    # Add sheet
    addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    
    # Write data
    writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = group_df)
  })
  
  saveWorkbook(wb, file, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  message("Excel written to: ", file)
}


```
